description: Synthetic NDJSON and TTY stderr bytes from pinned cli._progress with injected monotonic clock for TtyProgress (default ctor documented gap).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-cli-progress-tty-default-clock: Python TtyProgress() binds time.monotonic at construction; Rust MonotonicClock injects a floor so the first incomplete event always renders without wall-clock delay (not byte-compared here).
